reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to recruit new members into a binary network using a sponsoring link and to place recruits in left or right downline legs. The dashboard also displays leadership rank, bonus, and sponsored-member metrics, showing that the tutorial facilitates recruitment-dependent participation rather than reporting on or criticizing the scheme.

citations.quote: The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network.
As we have a binary system, we have two leg's, left and right.
You can always choose whether you join new member left or right because this is binary.

opening.argument: The walkthrough does not promise earnings, guaranteed returns, or a particular financial outcome. Instead, it limits the immediate purpose of the transaction password, expressly saying registration can proceed without using that function, and states that the new member is placed into the system "without any payment at the first moment." Those qualifications support reading this as a preliminary account-setup procedure whose risks and later conditions are not resolved by the video, rather than deceptive solicitation. The evidence establishes a registration step, but not that viewers are promised profit or misled about what they receive.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The sponsoring-link and left/right language shows how the account is configured, but it does not establish a promised return or deceptive claim. Likewise, the dashboard frame is evidence of interface content, not proof that the speaker guaranteed earnings or concealed a required payment. The prosecution converts a procedural description into a conclusion about fraud without identifying a false assurance.

citations.quote: The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network.
You will be placed into your binary system without any payment at the first moment.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a guarantee does not make the activity ordinary or non-promotional. The video gives viewers operational instructions for recruiting and positioning people in a binary structure, including use of a personal sponsoring link. Saying there is no payment "at the first moment" also leaves open later payment or participation requirements; it is not a risk warning or a disclosure that the opportunity is unsafe.

citations.quote: The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network.

opening.argument: The primary format is an operational demonstration: it begins by explaining that the video will show how to join a new member from the back office, then walks through placement settings and the account form. The speaker explains where to choose left or right, what information to enter, and how email confirmation completes registration. That is consistent with software and business-process instruction. The presence of a sponsoring link within the demonstrated interface identifies the system's workflow, but does not by itself prove that the video is a solicitation rather than a tutorial showing how the tool operates.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling it a tutorial does not answer what the tutorial teaches. This is not a neutral explanation of software features: it instructs the operator to send a personal sponsoring link, select a recruit's position, and add that person to a downline. The procedural format makes the recruitment activity easier to perform; it does not turn that activity into non-promotional education.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The described workflow is specifically for adding recruits, not merely demonstrating generic account software. The speaker explains how to distribute a personal link and how placement affects the network's legs. A tutorial can still be promotional when its practical lesson is how to recruit participants into the speaker's network.

opening.argument: The supplied material shows an account-registration workflow, not the core mechanics needed to establish a scam. The speaker says the described registration occurs without payment at the first moment, and separately explains that the transaction password is used for transfers or gift codes but is skipped for registration. The visible form is a conventional profile-creation form with name, username, email, password, country, and phone fields. Whatever the broader business model may be, this record does not show a guaranteed return, an actual deposit, or a payment being demanded as part of the demonstrated step.

citations.quote: This is a password that is needed to transfer money out from a system. Making gift codes or transferring money to other members on the downline.
if you want to register a new member, this function is not important, so we will skip this at the current moment.
You will be placed into your binary system without any payment at the first moment.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on what is absent from one registration step while overlooking the mechanism that is present: recruitment into a binary downline, personal sponsorship, and placement in a power leg. The fact that money is not paid at the first moment does not negate later participation economics, and the dashboard visibly contains bonus, sponsored-member, and account categories. The evidence therefore supports recruitment-dependent promotion even without a displayed deposit.

citations.quote: The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network.
the Sponsor wants a new member to be placed in the Power-Leg.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification need not require that the video display the entire payment lifecycle. The speaker expressly teaches recruitment through a personal sponsoring link and placement in left or right legs, while the dashboard includes bonus and sponsored-member categories. Those features connect the registration task to a tiered recruitment structure; the phrase "without any payment at the first moment" describes timing, not the absence of an underlying financial scheme.
